headline: MAGIC CARPET now runs nine worlds — and lets you pick where to start
lede: The campaign tripled: nine named worlds from Verdant Isles to The Last Sky, quotas 115 to 265, three atmospheres cycling like the original's 45-level arcs. The title screen gained a WORLD SELECT — arrows or thumb-sized gold chevrons pick your starting world, any other key goes.

notes.text: Nine worlds, 60/60: the balance sweep found two seeds that soft-locked when the wizard's hoard became the only supply left at zero mana — the quota curve was rebuilt around pearls-always-cover-demand, and all sixty seeds now win the full campaign.
Economy rule learned: a hoard you can't pay a spell to crack is not a fallback. Hoards are bonus mana again, exactly where the original's land was.

carpetcheck gained a WORLDS section (escalation law, supply floor, level pins, select-zone geometry, source pins) plus real-browser gates: arrow-cycling, start-at-cursor, and 390px touchscreen chevron taps. Three mutants, each caught exactly.

The ship rode out the #601 freeze cleanly: the QA lane's archeryplay gate fix landed, the studio merge loop squashed nine-worlds into main at 8d5d8de, and production now carries THE LAST SKY at jalfern.com/retrogames/magic-carpet.
